name: Ni Yu Zuori zhi Hai
source:
Xiamen, Fujian Province, 2024. One day, 19-year-old Xiamen University student Gu Mengzhi meets a sea spirit named Coral, and the two quickly become close. However, as their bond deepens, a stranger appears and disrupts everything. The stranger seems to want to kidnap Mengzhi for some reason. Soon, Mengzhi realizes she's been caught up in a conspiracy. What's really going on? Will Mengzhi and Coral be able to unravel the truth and escape safely?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2024年，福建省厦门市。某天，19岁的厦门大学学生顾梦之遇见了一只名叫珊瑚的海神，两人很快就变得亲近起来。然而，随着他们的联系加深，一个陌生人的出现扰乱了一切。陌生人似乎出于某种原因想要绑架梦之。很快，梦芝意识到自己陷入了一场阴谋。究竟发生了什么？梦之和珊瑚能否查明真相并安全逃脱？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849190/]Steam[/url]]
